lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 10-12 diffuse, low-contrast high-luminance spots distributed irregularly across its visible lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct yellow-pigmented elliptical object is located on the ventral silhouette posterior to the pectoral fin.
